{{Quote|What the Sith ''want'', they ''take''. Do you think we need help from you&hellip; or ''them''?|The Sith, to Tenno while pointing to the latter's dead friends|<ref name="Tales17" />}}
A [[Tattoo/Legends|tattooed]] '''Human''' was a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] active by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. He traveled to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceriun]] when a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] carrying a [[Unidentified Jedi holocron (Ceriun)|Jedi holocron]] had crash-landed there. Pinpointing the [[Holocron/Legends|holocron's]] location to a hut where a group of young local [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] were fighting several of their tribe's adults over the possession of the retrieved [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifact]], the Sith then arrived there.

The Sith took the holocron but was stopped from leaving by [[Tenno]], who had led the young farmers' attempts in order for them to potentially be rewarded with becoming [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]]. Enraged, the Sith [[Death/Legends|murdered]] Tenno's friends, proclaiming the locals' efforts to be meaningless. However, he did thank Tenno and, before departing the site of the slaughter, threatened the present adults into leaving the young [[Gender/Legends|man]] alone.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Shall I now give you your ''reward''?|The Sith, to Tenno and his friends before attacking them|<ref name="Tales17" />}}
[[File:TattooedSithTenno-Tales17.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Sith spared Tenno's life after killing his friends.]]
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] individual was part of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]<ref name="Tales17" /> tradition of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;focused [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> at some point by [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]].<ref name="1000 BBY">Although {{Tales|17|All for You}} is nominally set "1,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]," which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], that book and other sources such as ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' also establish that the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], whose contemporary existence is depicted as public knowledge in "All for You," entered a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]-long period of hiding in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]]. Therefore the events of "All for You" must be set at some point by that year.</ref> Two [[Local day/Legends|days]] after a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] carrying<ref name="Tales17" /> a [[Unidentified Jedi holocron (Ceriun)|Jedi holocron]]<ref name="CSWE Geenor" /> crash-landed on the<ref name="Tales17" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ceriun system/Legends|Ceriun system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ceriun]], the Sith arrived there in search of the [[Holocron/Legends|artifact]].<ref name="Tales17" /> He<ref name="CSWE Geenor" /> then pinpointed the holocron's location to a hut in the planet's [[Drop Canyon]], wherein a group of young [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] of a local<ref name="Tales17" /> tribe<ref name="CSWE Morro">{{CSWECite|II|331|Morro}}</ref> was at the [[Time/Legends|time]] violently fighting several of the tribe's adults for the possession of the [[Jedi artifact/Legends|artifact]]. Arriving at the hut on his [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], the [[darksider]] slammed open the structure's door and, ignoring the scene of carnage there, retrieved the holocron and returned to his conveyance.<ref name="Tales17" />

As the Sith was putting the artifact into a bag on the bike, he was interrupted by [[Tenno]], a young [[Gender/Legends|man]] who had orchestrated the plan to take the holocron from the tribe's adults and turn it over to the Sith in exchange for him and his friends potentially being made [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentices]] as a reward for the deed. The Sith listened to Tenno explaining his reasoning before rhetorically asking whether he should give the young farmers their "reward." At that point, the enraged Sith ignited his [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and started [[Death/Legends|killing]] Tenno's friends, including [[Flass]]<ref name="Tales17" /> and [[Geenor]].<ref name="CSWE Geenor" />

Panicking, Tenno ran away from the slaughter, only to collide with the darksider again. The Sith then derogatorily explained that he found Tenno's attempts to help him irrelevant and unimpressive, further claiming that the farmer had no conception whatsoever of the true nature of one being a Sith. Nevertheless, while the darksider subsequently was climbing on his [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] bike, he thanked Tenno and, before driving away from the site, ordered the adult farmers to leave the young man alone, threatening that he would know if they disobeyed the order.<ref name="Tales17" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You have no idea what it ''means'' to be a Sith. But I ''thank'' you, anyway.|The Sith, to Tenno|<ref name="Tales17" />}}
The Sith was a Human with [[Color/Legends|tan]] skin and [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with light-colored irises and red sclerae. He had golden-colored patterned [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]] that covered his face, neck, and upper [[Limb/Legends|arms]]. The Sith displayed an apparent focused and collected manner while pursuing the search for the Jedi holocron; however, he launched an enraged and murderous attack when Tenno relayed to him his ambitions and motivation behind his attempt to secure the artifact for the Sith. The darksider then espoused the philosophy that the Sith simply took whatever they wanted, and that Tenno's efforts were therefore meaningless. Ultimately, however, the Sith did thank the young farmer for his assistance.<ref name="Tales17" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Sith was skilled in the lethal use of a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].<ref name="Tales17" />

==Equipment==
The Sith wore a black sleeveless [[shirt]], black pants and [[Boot/Legends|boots]], and a double [[Belt/Legends|belt]] with several pouches. He also carried his lightsaber attached to the belt. The Sith utilized a speeder bike that resembled<ref name="Tales17" /> the [[Razalon/Legends|Razalon]] [[FC-20 speeder bike/Legends|FC-20 speeder bike]], used by the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]]<ref name="DB">{{DB|vehicle|sithspeeder|Sith speeder}}</ref> roughly a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]] later.<ref name="32 BBY">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|I}}, which include the use of an [[FC-20 speeder bike/Legends|FC-20 speeder bike]] by the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Sith]], to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tales17.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The tattooed Sith was introduced in a comic story in ''Star Wars Tales'' 17.]]
The tattooed Sith first appeared in "[[All for You]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Adam Gallardo]], pencilled by [[Greg Titus]], and published in the [[Star Wars Tales 17|seventeenth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic-book series<ref name="Tales17" /> on [[October 1]], [[2003]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53995/star_wars_tales_1999_17|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) #17}}</ref> [[2008]]'s ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' contains a pair of apparent errors related to the Sith's portrayal in the comic. Firstly, the book implies that [[Ka'arn]] was among the group of friends whom the Sith killed,<ref name="CSWE Geenor" /> whereas in fact the former was Tenno's [[Parent/Legends|father]] who was killed earlier by his son.<ref name="Tales17" />

Secondly, according to the book, the Sith killed the individuals who had "recovered" the Jedi holocron&mdash;which the book implies refers to<ref name="CSWE Morro" /> those who retrieved the artifact from the crash-landed Jedi [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. "All for You" in fact establishes that the holocron was retrieved by a group of adults and only depicts the Sith killing several of the young farmers who had later attempted to take possession of the artifact from them.<ref name="Tales17" />
